summary: Backend regression after CORS regex + clean(lead) edits. Ran 9 pytest cases against direct backend (CORS preflight) and preview URL (auth/leads/dashboard/public). All 9 passed. No ObjectId/_id leakage detected in /api/leads/{id} response.

verification_details.cors_preflight_autonovaia_ca: OPTIONS /api/auth/login → 200, ACAO=https://autonovaia.ca, ACA-Credentials=true, POST in allow-methods
verification_details.cors_actual_post: POST /api/auth/login with Origin https://autonovaia.ca → 200, ACAO present ('*' or origin as expected under CORS_ORIGINS='*')
verification_details.auth_login: admin@autoacquire.ai / Admin123! → 200 with token + user.email match
verification_details.leads_list: GET /api/leads?page=1&page_size=10 → 200, paginated dict with items/total/page/page_size; items include seller_name, vehicle_label, appointment_status
verification_details.lead_detail: GET /api/leads/{id} → 200, JSON body includes lead/seller/vehicle/conversation/messages/score/matches/appointment/notes; recursive scan found no bson.ObjectId or '_id' keys

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~959 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting routers (leads, dashboard, public, auth) into modules for maintainability.

Lead-detail endpoint calls clean(lead) once at line 408 and again inside the return dict at line 424 — the second call is a no-op since clean() mutates in place, but the redundancy is a code-smell worth cleaning up (either remove the earlier standalone clean(lead) or drop the second one).
allow_origin_regex correctly locks to autonovaia.ca / onrender.com / ravijha.co subdomains — safe permanent net.
